list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The discrete polyanion [Pr4(H2O)6(pzdc)2As6W58O206]38− comprises two identical Pr2-containing arsenotungstate subunits bridged by two pzdc ligands in a staggered arrangement. Each subunit incorporates three trilacunary AsW9O33 fragments and two WO6 octahedra. The four Pr centers form part of a distorted central Pr4W4 unit supported by six AsW9O33 fragments.

synthesis.procedure: Dissolve K14[As2W19O67(H2O)] in 15 mL water. Add pyrazine-2,3-dicarboxylic acid, PrCl3·6H2O, and LiCl successively with stirring at room temperature. After 10 min, adjust the pH to 4.0 with 1 M LiOH. Heat at 60 °C for 1 h, then retain the clear filtrate at ambient temperature for crystallization.
synthesis.temperature: Room temperature during reagent addition; 60 °C during heating; ambient temperature during crystallization
synthesis.time: 10 min before pH adjustment; 1 h at 60 °C; crystals isolated after two weeks
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Keep the clear filtrate at ambient temperature; isolate green stick-like crystals after two weeks.

title: Pyrazine dicarboxylate-bridged arsenotungstate: synthesis, characterization, and catalytic activities in epoxidation of olefins and oxidation of alcohols
